description.value: Embassy Inn is an 80-room hotel occupying a five-storey building in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, within easy walking distance of the Inner Harbour, Beacon Hill Park, and the BC Legislature. Rooms range from traditional queens to suites with full kitchens, all with balconies and in-room safe. The hotel offers a complimentary hot buffet breakfast and surface or underground parking, making it a comfortable downtown base for cyclists exploring the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active, operating hotel with 80 guest rooms and suites in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood. Wi-Fi is confirmed via both the OSM tag (internet_access=wlan) and multiple website passages ('free and reliable high speed Wi-Fi', 'Complimentary WI-FI'). No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content; the website does mention surface and underground parking but nothing bike-specific. An outdated attraction listing ('On now till December 31, 2019') suggests portions of the site have not been recently updated, though the core hotel content and booking functionality appear current.
concerns: Attractions subpage contains a listing marked 'On now till December 31, 2019', suggesting portions of the site have not been updated in several years — core hotel content appears current but worth monitoring.
Phone number and street address could not be cross-confirmed from website text (contact page renders only a form with no displayed address or phone number).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating downtown Victoria hotel with an active website and booking functionality; a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: 80-room hotel ... Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood ... no mention of bike storage or cyclist-specific amenities
